This generation is working harder than their parents but  making less money. The Black-White wealth gap is widening again . Income inequality is exploding,  the very concept of the American Dream is hanging in the balance right now. But I’m a believer that our generation can redeem that Dream again.

Trump's own first-term national security leaders warned us: re-elect him, and he'd put politics ahead of the safety of our nation. That's exactly what's unfolding.

Trump is appointing loyalists instead of people with the national security experience that the job of keeping Americans safe demands.

This corruption puts the American people in danger.

Don’t believe the hype on Trump’s deal with Iran. This isn’t peace or strength—it’s a dangerous giveaway. The Strait of Hormuz was open before Trump’s war. Now he’s handing Iran billions in sanctions relief to rebuild their military. 

This is a disaster.

America’s mental health crisis is touching every community—especially Black men, where suicide rates have risen 25% and far too few are getting help. We must expand access to care, support our veterans and youth, and fund community services. 

Strength isn’t suffering in silence. Sometimes the strongest words you can say are: “I need help.”

This grift must end. We deserve better.

It has been 100 days of this war in Iran and President Trump keeps telling us the war is “finished,” “very close to having a deal,” “essentially won.”

How many times must we hear “just a little longer” while lives are lost, costs soar, and instability grows?

A budget is a moral document—a clear statement of our deepest values as a nation.

Trump is pouring billions into his lavish new ballroom, ICE detention centers, and reckless wars—while families struggle with rising costs of health insurance, gas, and groceries.

This is not right. We must choose people over palaces.

Twenty years ago this summer, I raised Newark’s first Pride Flag at City Hall—& the hate calls came fast. But I vowed: I won’t marry anyone until everyone can. Then at midnight in 2013, love finally won. Couples of every background said “I do” as joy overflowed. Love knows no barriers.
